claim: SMC provides normalizing-constant/unnormalized-target identities under its assumptions; motivates ratio-of-sums pooling. The exact aggregation formula is stated as our algebra, not quoted as a theorem about our implementation.
source: Andrieu, Doucet and Holenstein (2010), Particle Markov chain Monte Carlo methods, JRSS B72:269–342, doi:10.1111/j.1467-9868.2009.00736.x
locator: Printedp.298, §5.1, paragraph beginning Note finally; equations36–37 extended-target construction.
limitation: Does not establish convergence, aircraft calibration, or a five-percent criterion for this implementation.
